baseline.registration_num: FARA registration number of the registrant
baseline.foreign_principle_name: name of the foreign principal represented
baseline.file_date: date of filing/signing this form, not the generic printed form revision date
baseline.signer_name: name of the individual signing this form
baseline.signer_title: title of the individual signing this form

clarified.registration_num: numeric registration identifier written beside Registration No./Registration Number. Copy the digits. Not FARA, an OMB number, phone number, or date
clarified.registrant_name: name of the FARA-registered organization/entity. On a Short Form use the registrant FOR WHOM THE INDIVIDUAL IS ACTING, not the individual named at the top
clarified.foreign_principle_name: name of the foreign principal represented by that registrant, not the individual or registrant organization
clarified.file_date: date of signature in the EXECUTION/signature section. Do not use the received-by-registration-unit stamp or form revision/expiry date
clarified.signer_name: printed name of the person signing the EXECUTION/signature section. Copy a printed name if shown there; do not guess from an illegible signature
clarified.signer_title: explicitly printed title of the person signing the EXECUTION/signature section. Return null if no title is explicitly printed there
